_comment: SET INDICES source of truth. Written at inception by the build session (Aug 24 2026); appended weekly by the Monday trend-scan STEP 3.6 re-mark. SCHEMA per index: base (always 100.00), inception, divisor (current), divisorLog[{date, before, after, why}], universe[{num, name, rarity}] (ALL slots in scope, priced or not), basket[{num, name, rarity, price, basis, asOf}] (only cards with sourced SOLD reads), history[{date, level, basketValue, divisor, priced, note}]. MATH: level = sum(basket prices) / divisor. INCLUSION (a universe card gets its first sourced sold comp): newDivisor = oldDivisor * (basketValueAfter / basketValueBefore) -- the level MUST be identical before and after; log it in divisorLog. RULES: sold comps only, dated + attributed, never asks, never estimated; base/inception/history rows are immutable; an index is a measurement, not a call. BCB26._note: PRE-ACTIVATION per-set Bowman index #1 (built 2026-09-07 by bcb26-index-prebuild, charter 4.8). Universe rows use {id, number, player, team, tab, first?, board?} (the Pokémon tickers use {num, name, rarity}; /indices reads only .length). basket rows, once STEP 3.6 writes them: {id, number, player, tab, price, basis:'ask (eBay verified, engine)'|'sold (SCP)', asOf, units?, prevPrice?, prevAsOf?}. AUTOS 15% single-card cap = fractional units at (re)constitution, logged in divisorLog. Activation: first re-mark where verified asks cover ≥60% of chase-basket value → divisor = basketValue/100, inception = that date, history[0] = {level 100.00}, status 'live', basis stays 'ask' (labeled on-page) until ≥60% SCP sold coverage → restate to 'sold' via a logged divisor adjustment (level identical before/after). Never blend asks and solds in one basket. Re-marks: every board-touching run (Mon/Tue/Fri) through street+21d, then weekly.
BCB26.name: 2026 Bowman Chrome Chase Index
BCB26.basisLabel: ask basis (labeled) — restates to hammer basis at ≥60% SCP sold coverage
BCB26.universeNote: Checklist as published 2026-08-21 (Topps official checklist PDF + Checklist Insider (autograph list still filling in)); the CPA autograph list was still filling in. STEP 3.6 re-syncs the universe from data/sets/2026-bowman-chrome-baseball.json each re-mark — new cards enter via logged divisor adjustments.
BCB26.activationRule: ≥60% of chase-basket value with verified asks; restates to hammer basis via logged divisor adjustment at ≥60% SCP sold coverage
